tools.name: archive_stale_report_exports
tools.description: Moves generated report export files older than a given number of days from the live exports folder into an archive folder, and records each move in the report index database with its new path.

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory where stale exports are moved

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Age threshold in days based on file modification time

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite report index database

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    moved: int = 0
    skipped: int = 0
    moved_files: list = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list = field(default_factory=list)


@function_tool
def archive_stale_report_exports(exports_dir: str, archive_dir: str, older_than_days: int, db_path: str) -> ArchiveResult:
    result = ArchiveResult()
    src = Path(exports_dir)
    dst = Path(archive_dir)
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        for f in src.iterdir():
            if not f.is_file():
                continue
            if f.stat().st_mtime >= cutoff:
                result.skipped += 1
                continue
            target = dst / f.name
            if target.exists():
                result.skipped += 1
                result.errors.append(f"{f.name}: already exists in archive")
                continue
            try:
                shutil.move(str(f), str(target))
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE report_exports SET path = ?, status = 'archived' WHERE path = ?",
                    (str(target), str(f)),
                )
                result.moved += 1
                result.moved_files.append(f.name)
            except OSError as exc:
                result.errors.append(f"{f.name}: {exc}")
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

tools.name: email_weekly_report_digest
tools.description: Sends an email with the weekly analytics report summary to a recipient, with an optional link to the full dashboard.

params.name: summary_text
params.description: Plain text summary of the key metrics

params.name: dashboard_url
params.description: Optional link to the full dashboard

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool


@dataclass
class DigestResult:
    sent: bool
    recipient: str
    subject: str


@function_tool
def email_weekly_report_digest(recipient: str, report_title: str, summary_text: str, dashboard_url: str = "") -> DigestResult:
    subject = f"Weekly analytics digest: {report_title}"
    body = summary_text
    if dashboard_url:
        body += f"\n\nFull dashboard: {dashboard_url}"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = os.environ["REPORTS_FROM_ADDRESS"]
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ["SMTP_HOST"], int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        server.send_message(msg)
    return DigestResult(sent=True, recipient=recipient, subject=subject)
